title: ENLARGEMENTS OR EXTENSIONS
previewText: In all districts, any conforming use which is in violation of the supplementary use regulations may be enlarged or extended, provided that the extended or enlarged floor area shall not create new instances of such violation or increase the degree of violation previously existing.
